messages:
Maria G.: Quick postmortem follow-up from tonight's KV eviction-driven latency spike. posting proposed action items here.
Dmitri: TL;DR: eviction thrash when many sessions with long prefixes hit cold cache -> batching stalls -> latency spike. saw eviction ratio spike to ~0.9 briefly.
Carla: grabbing traces and logs now. will attach short excerpt.
oncall-bot: Incident logged RINF-2314 by Maria G.  Draft postmortem at https://redwood.internal/incidents/RINF-2314
Maria G.: Proposal for incident-driven test additions:
- regression: "long-session small-state" harness (simulate 2k sessions, session lengths 4k-12k tokens, ensure per-session KV reuse)
- promptset: add "session-churn" set (40 examples) that mixes long context reuse and sudden short bursts
- load tests: ramp+burst scenario with controlled KV cold/warm transitions every 30s
- chaos drill: induce eviction via memory pressure on selected nodes, verify graceful fallback and alerting
Sam: Sounds good. for the harness we need a per-session token pattern generator, and deterministic replay so results are comparable.
Dmitri: add an alert: sustained kv_eviction_rate > 0.5 for 2m triggers P0 weathering. also add an SLO check for median token latency.
Carla: created ticket RINF-2319 for harness + infra glue. assigning to @Carla (harness) and @Sam (infra). due 2026-04-10.
Elaine: I'll take promptset curation. plan: 40 examples, 10 with heavy prefix reuse, 10 with interleaved short bursts, 20 chaotic mixes. PR target 2026-03-29.
Sam: infra plan: spin up a test cluster with 4 small nodes, load generator container, and an orchestration script. will push a helm chart and example make commands by EOD.
Maria G.: Action items (to paste into postmortem):
- A1: RINF-2319 regression harness (owner: Carla) - due 2026-04-10
- A2: RINF-2320 promptset "session-churn" (owner: Elaine) - due 2026-03-29
- A3: RINF-2321 eviction alert + SLO checker (owner: Dmitri) - due 2026-03-26
- A4: RINF-2322 chaos drill runbook + scheduled run (owner: Sam) - due 2026-04-12
Dmitri: I'll draft the alert + add a grafana dashboard panel for eviction ratio and batching headroom. query proto:
```
(sum(rate(kv_evictions[2m])) by (cluster) / sum(rate(kv_requests[2m])) by (cluster))
```
Carla: WIP harness command (example):
```
./bin/session-play --sessions=2000 --pattern=session-churn --cluster=dev --seed=42
```
Elaine: sharing a short prompt snippet for review: "User: continue the conversation where we left off about travel plans; System: preserve prior KB and reuse recent rodent of context" (will refine examples).
Sam: scheduling: I'll create a recurring 30-min drill slot weekly for 5 weeks post-mortem; first run next Tues 09:00 PST. invite incoming.
Maria G.: can we add a checkpoint that the regression suite must run against the dedicated preprod with representative cache config before closing A1?
Carla: yes, adding that to RINF-2319 checklist.
Dmitri: I'll validate metrics after alert deploy and re-run historic load to see if thresholds sensible.
Maria G.: Great. I'll update the postmortem doc with these AIs, owners, due dates, and link tickets. tagging product & SRE for visibility. thanks, folks. :thumbsup:
